notes.title: Little Legend Kickstarter is LIVE!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nevermind/little-legend-the-2d-open-world-adventure][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ycpOXcjElz6okgdoB4/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

Hello, Adventurers!

We are excited to announce that the Kickstarter for [b]Little Legend[/b] is LIVE!
You can watch the trailer for the game and learn about it's univers here:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nevermind/little-legend-the-2d-open-world-adventure][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34320554/76aa68bd144c0806ff68007d0bd5a24301637f82.png[/img][/url]

You can also follow us on our social media channels

Read about us on [url=https://twitter.com/LittleLegendDev]Twitter[/url]
Ask us questions on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/63uHsA3]Discord[/url]
Like and Share us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/LittleLegendGame/]Facebook[/url]

[b]All support, retweets, likes, are really appreciated!
We count on you to spread the word![/b]

We will regularly post updates about our progression - so please be sure to add Little Legend to your [b]Wishlist[/b] and [b]Follow the game[/b] to see every new update as soon as it drops!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34320554/5f701891481b8a236ad66f9893432d59ed224302.gif[/img]

[h1]Thank you :)[/h1]

[i]The NEVERMIND Team[/i]
